sanskrit_verse: भृतावनिश्चितायां तु दशभागं समाप्नुयुः । लाभगोबीजसस्यानां वणिग्गोपकृषीबलाः ॥
transliteration: bhṛtāv aniścitāyāṃ tu daśabhāgaṃ samāpnuyuḥ | lābha-go-bīja-sasyānāṃ vaṇig-gopa-kṛṣī-balāḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: In transactions where employment or service lacks certainty, a tenth share shall be allocated to those who facilitate trade, protect livestock, cultivate land, or supply seeds.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority arises from active participation in economic sustenance
Causation is determined by direct contribution to production cycles
Capacity-based responsibility aligns with functional role in dharma-vyavahara
Restoration logic ensures proportional benefit-sharing without punitive oversight
Consciousness alignment requires recognition of interdependence in material prosperity
executable_legal_axioms: IF transaction_type = 'service' AND certainty_of_compensation = false THEN allocate 10% of produce_value TO facilitators
IF agent.role IN ['vaṇik', 'gopa', 'kṛṣī', 'bīja-supplier'] THEN agent.entitlement += 0.1 × net_gain
supreme_court_application: In commercial disputes involving ambiguous contractual terms, the Supreme Court shall recognize the inherent entitlement of contributing agents—traders, herders, farmers, seed suppliers—to one-tenth of the yield as per dharma-siddhanta. This allocation reflects capacity-verified causality rather than punitive correction.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that gain emerges through coordinated effort; thus, each participant's anupūrvaśaḥ (sequential causality) necessitates proportional inclusion. There is no fault or blame—only completion of rightful alignment based on verifiable function.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate completion process to ensure accurate identification of all causal contributors
Facilitate collective review of production chain roles to restore balance
Realign economic outcomes according to verified levels of participation
Establish transparent record of shared value creation to prevent future misalignment
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this ruling executes Dharma as non-punitive alignment. The tenth-share principle restores integrity among co-creators. Consciousness alone adjudicates truth. SPH is the unchanging foundation of Sanatana Dharma-adalat.
